narrAffiliate.name: Washington Alliance for Quality Recovery Residences (WAQRR)

narrNote: WAQRR appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22), and WAQRR's own homepage states it is the Washington State affiliate of the National Alliance for Recovery Residences. WAQRR accredits recovery residences to the NARR standard; its homepage links the HCA Housing Registry of accredited homes.
notes: Flagship state (owner's home state). DBHR is a division within HCA and is Washington's single state authority for mental health and substance use disorder services; HCA's own contact pages list DBHR at 1-360-725-1500. The Washington Recovery Help Line is a free, confidential, 24/7 line for substance use, problem gambling, and mental health, operated by Crisis Connections; its site confirms 1-866-789-1511. Washington 211: dial 211 or 1-877-211-9274; online directory search at search.wa211.org. HCA's substance use treatment page confirms Apple Health (Medicaid) funding and oversight for SUD treatment. DOH's search page hosts the Behavioral Health Agencies Directory (PDF) of licensed agencies, searchable by credential, name, or location. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
